newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Q1 real retail sales rise 1.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech Q1 real retail sales rise 1.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech real retail sales rose 4.5 percent in March compared with same month in 1996 putting first quarter retail sales 1.1 percent higher than in the same period last year, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Monday.
The CSU added that total internal trade in March rose by 6.4 percent year-on-year putting internal trade in the first quarter up 2.4 percent compared with same period in 1996.
